title: PPG-MS19 — Security Hardening (IEC 62443 SL-2)
description: Closes the cybersecurity exposure surfaced by R16 scrutiny (score 31). Locks down the write-capable surfaces (FOCAS feed override, OPC-UA writes, Fusion Add-In HTTP bridge) to IEC 62443 SL-2. Adds Ed25519 sidecar signing, multi-tenant row-level security, SBOM/CVE response process, OT/IT segmentation, append-only audit ledger, penetration test cadence.
rationale: Closes the cybersecurity exposure surfaced by R16 scrutiny (score 31). Locks down the write-capable surfaces (FOCAS feed override, OPC-UA writes, Fusion Add-In HTTP bridge) to IEC 62443 SL-2. Adds Ed25519 sidecar signing, multi-tenant row-level security, SBOM/CVE response process, OT/IT segmentation, append-only audit ledger, penetration test cadence.

units.title: mTLS + cert pinning for FOCAS write paths
units.scope: Replace plaintext FOCAS handle with mTLS-wrapped tunnel; pin Fanuc controller certs; require valid client cert per shop. Block L3 in PPG-MS1 until handshake succeeds.

units.title: OPC-UA Sign+Encrypt + UserTokenPolicy
units.scope: OPC-UA SecurityMode=SignAndEncrypt + Basic256Sha256; UserToken=x509 (per-shop cert); namespace-index pinning with version-stamp.

units.title: Ed25519 sidecar signature + key rotation
units.scope: Replace SHA-256 only with Ed25519 detached signature; key in OS keychain; rotation per SecureKeyManager; load fail-closed on signature verify.

units.title: Multi-tenant row-level security + per-tenant encryption-at-rest
units.scope: tenant_id on every variance/calibration/telemetry row; Postgres RLS policies; per-shop encryption key; ITAR co-mingling block.

units.title: SBOM (CycloneDX) + npm audit gate + CVE response SLA
units.scope: Generate SBOM per release; npm audit --audit-level=high in CI; Snyk weekly scan; 7-day CVE response SLA; signed releases.

units.title: OT/IT network segmentation manifest
units.scope: Document required network topology (shop subnet vs office vs cloud); deny-list cloud destinations on ITAR-flagged emit; reference architecture diagram for customer install.

units.title: Append-only WORM audit ledger for L3 writes + tier promotions
units.scope: Hash-chained audit log; 7-year retention; queryable by SOC2 auditor; signed entries.

units.title: Penetration test + SOC2 Type I gap analysis
units.scope: External pen-test of L3 write surfaces + Fusion HTTP bridge; SOC2 Type I gap analysis; remediation roadmap to Type II.
